description.value: Hail Mary's is a small, irreverent local bar and restaurant on East Broadway in East Vancouver, offering creative cocktails with names like 'Exorcism' and 'The Resurrection' alongside a snack-forward food menu including house-made potato chips, Jamaican jerk chicken patties, and double-baked nachos. The spot runs strictly first-come, first-served with no reservations, keeping things unpretentious and drop-in friendly. Vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free options are woven throughout the menu.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and corroborates the OSM address (670 East Broadway, Vancouver BC V5T 1X6) and phone number (604-829-7032). The dinner menu explicitly labels several items as vegan or GF (tortilla chips and guacamole marked 'g/f & vegan', Beyond meat burger, chili lime tofu skewers, GF chicken wings without breading). No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, wi-fi, or takeout appears anywhere on the site; the website focuses entirely on food and drink menus.
concerns: Website contains conflicting hours information across pages: the main content and contact page show one set of hours while the footer widget shows a substantially different and likely erroneous set, suggesting a site-builder template artifact was never corrected.
No evidence of bike parking, water refill, or any cyclist-specific amenities on the website or in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Hail Mary's is a legitimate local bar-restaurant with dietary-inclusive menu items, but no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from the website. The venue's bar-first character and absence of any cyclist-welcoming signals make it a marginal WWC fit without on-site verification.
